usageNotes: Reads a file from inside a running VM via the QEMU Guest Agent (qemu-guest-agent must be installed and running in the guest). The response is capped at 16 MiB; check the `truncated` field in the response — if true, use the `offset` param to page through the remainder. The caller must hold `VM.GuestAgent.FileRead` or `VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted` on `/vms/{vmid}`.

examples.summary: Read /etc/hostname from a Linux VM (decoded, first 1 KB)

tips: Set decode=false if you need to forward the raw base64 payload (e.g., for binary files or when the caller handles decoding itself).
Use offset + count together to paginate large files; always check `truncated: true` before assuming you have the full content.
The 16 MiB hard cap is enforced server-side regardless of the count value supplied.
Guest agent must be running — if the VM is powered off or the agent service is stopped, the call will fail with a timeout or connection error.
On Windows guests, use Windows-style paths (e.g., C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts).
